items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I went with Tom Jones in '69 and '70, on the road show.

ctx.x: I didn't even know it. At that time, you know, ...(?)... It's too bad. He had a strong body.

After '68... In '69 and '70 I went there and accompanied Tom Jones a little. He was at Tucson, and I gave him a call. I gave him a call at Tucson; he was resting up there. That's the last time I spoke to T-Bone. That was in '70.
You were on the road with Tom Jones.
